column3: NASB follows the critical text (“and beyond the Jordan”) and renders “as He had been accustomed” as “according to His custom.”
NASB supplies “some” and “Jesus”; “husband” is rendered “man.”

NASB includes “God,” a Textus Receptus word; the quotation is in capitals.
NASB has no “and will be joined to his wife,” which the critical text includes in brackets.
Close to the Greek; the quotation is in capitals.
NASB renders “man” as “no man.”
